an8.22:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Vajjīsu viharati Hatthigāme.
an8.22:1.2: Tatra kho Bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi . . . pe . . . .
an8.22:1.3: Aṭṭhahi bhikkhave acchariyehi abbhutehi dhammehi samannāgataṃ Uggaṃ gahapatiṃ Hatthigāmakaṃ dhārethā ti.
an8.22:1.5: idaṃ vatvā Sugato uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ pāvisi. 3.
an8.22:2.1: Atha kho aññataro bhikkhu pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram ādāya yena Uggassa gahapatino Hatthigāmakassa nivesanaṃ ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
an8.22:2.2: Atha kho Uggo gahapati Hatthigāmako yena so bhikkhu ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho Uggaṃ gahapatiṃ Hatthigāmakaṃ so bhikkhu etad avoca:-- 4.
an8.22:2.3: Aṭṭhahi kho tvaṃ gahapati acchariyehi abbhutehi dhammehi samannāgato Bhagavatā vyākato.
an8.22:2.4: Katame te gahapati aṭṭha acchariyā abbhutā dhammā, yehi tvaṃ samannāgato Bhagavatā vyākato ti?
an8.22:3.2: katamehi ahaṃ aṭṭhahi acchariyehi abbhutehi dhammehi samannāgato Bhagavatā vyākato,
an8.22:3.3: api ca bhante ye me aṭṭha acchariyā abbhutā dhammā saṃvijjanti,
an8.22:3.4: te suṇāhi sādhukaṃ manasikarohi, bhāsissāmī' ti.
an8.22:3.5: ‘Evaṃ gahapatī' ti kho so bhikkhu Uggassa gahapatino Hatthigāmakassa paccassosi.
an8.22:3.7: Yadāhaṃ bhante Nāgavane paricaranto Bhagavantaṃ paṭhamaṃ dūrato 'va addasaṃ,
an8.22:3.8: saha dassanen' eva me bhante Bhagavato cittaṃ pasīdi surāmado ca pahīyi.
an8.22:3.9: Ayaṃ kho me bhante paṭhamo acchariyo abbhuto dhammo saṃvijjati.
an8.22:4.1: So kho ahaṃ bhante pasannacitto Bhagavantaṃ payirupāsiṃ.
an8.22:4.2: Tassa me Bhagavā anupubbikathaṃ kathesi, seyyathīdaṃ
an8.22:4.3: dānakathaṃ sīlakathaṃ saggakathaṃ, kāmānaṃ ādīnavaṃ okāraṃ saṃkilesaṃ nekkhamme ānisaṃsaṃ pakāsesi. 6.
an8.22:4.4: Yadā maṃ Bhagavā aññāsi kallacittaṃ muducittaṃ vinīvaraṇacittaṃ udaggacittaṃ pasannacittaṃ, atha yā buddhānaṃ sāmukkaṃsikā dhammadesanā, taṃ pakāsesi:
an8.22:4.6: Seyyathā pi nāma suddhaṃ vatthaṃ apagatakālakaṃ samma-d-eva rajanaṃ paṭiggaṇheyya,
an8.22:4.7: evam eva kho me tasmiṃ yeva āsane virajaṃ vītamalaṃ dhammacakkhuṃ udapādi
an8.22:4.8: ‘yaṃ kiñci samudayadhammaṃ, sabban taṃ nirodhamman' ti.
an8.22:4.9: So kho ahaṃ bhante diṭṭhadhammo pattadhammo viditadhammo pariyogāḷhadhammo tiṇṇavicikiccho vigatakathaṃkatho vesārajjappatto aparappaccayo Satthu sāsane tatth' eva buddhañ ca dhammañ ca saṅghañ ca saraṇaṃ agamāsiṃ brahmacariyapañcamāni ca sikkhāpadāni samādiyiṃ.
an8.22:4.10: Ayaṃ kho me bhante dutiyo acchariyo abbhuto dhammo saṃvijjati. 7.
an8.22:5.1: Tassa mayhaṃ bhante catasso komāriyo pajāpatiyo ahesuṃ.
an8.22:5.2: Atha khvāhaṃ bhante yena tā pajāpatiyo ten' upasaṅkamiṃ, upasaṅkamitvā tā pajāpatiyo etad avocaṃ
an8.22:5.4: yā icchati, idh' eva bhoge ca bhuñjatu puññāni ca karotu sakāni vā ñātikulāni gacchatu,
an8.22:5.5: hoti vā pana purisādhippāyo, kassa vo dammī' ti?
an8.22:5.6: Evaṃ vutte sā bhante jeṭṭhā pajāpati maṃ etad avoca
an8.22:5.8: Atha khvāhaṃ bhante taṃ purisaṃ pakkosāpetvā vāmena hatthena pajāpatiṃ gahetvā dakkhiṇena hatthena bhiṅgāraṃ gahetvā tassa purisassa oṇojesiṃ.
an8.22:5.9: Komāriṃ kho panāhaṃ bhante dāraṃ pariccajanto nābhijānāmi cittassa aññathattaṃ.
an8.22:5.10: Ayaṃ kho me bhante tatiyo acchariyo abbhuto dhammo saṃvijjati. 8.
an8.22:6.1: Saṃvijjanti kho pana me bhante kule bhogā,
an8.22:6.2: te ca kho appaṭivibhattā sīlavantehi kalyāṇadhammehi.
an8.22:6.3: Ayaṃ kho me bhante catuttho acchariyo abbhuto dhammo saṃvijjati. 9.
an8.22:7.1: Yaṃ kho panāhaṃ bhante bhikkhuṃ payirupāsāmi,
an8.22:7.3: So ce me bhante āyasmā dhammaṃ deseti,
an8.22:7.5: no ce me āyasmā dhammaṃ deseti, aham assa dhammaṃ desemi.
an8.22:7.6: Ayaṃ kho me bhante pañcamo acchariyo abbhuto dhammo saṃvijjati. 10.
an8.22:8.1: Anacchariyaṃ kho pana me bhante saṅghe nimantite devatā upasaṅkamitvā ārocenti
an8.22:8.2: ‘asuko gahapati bhikkhu ubhato bhāgavimutto, asuko paññāvimutto, asuko kāyasakkhī, asuko diṭṭhippatto, asuko saddhāvimutto, asuko dhammānusārī, asuko saddhānusārī, asuko sīlavā kalyāṇadhammo, asuko dussīlo pāpadhammo' ti.
an8.22:8.3: Saṅghaṃ kho panāhaṃ bhante parivisanto nābhijānāmi evaṃ cittaṃ uppādento
an8.22:8.4: ‘imassa vā thokaṃ demi imassa vā bahukan' ti.
an8.22:8.6: Ayaṃ kho me bhante chaṭṭho acchariyo abbhuto dhammo saṃvijjati. 11.
an8.22:9.1: Anacchariyaṃ kho pana maṃ bhante devatā upasaṅkamitvā ārocenti
an8.22:9.3: Evaṃ vutte ahaṃ bhante tā devatā evaṃ vadāmi
an8.22:9.4: ‘vadeyyātha vā evaṃ kho tumhe devatā no vā vadeyyātha, atha kho svākkhāto Bhagavatā dhammo' ti.
an8.22:9.5: Na kho panāhaṃ bhante abhijānāmi tatonidānaṃ cittassa unnatiṃ
an8.22:9.6: ‘maṃ vā devatā upasaṅkamanti, ahaṃ vā devatāhi saddhiṃ sallapāmī' ti.
an8.22:9.7: Ayaṃ kho me bhante sattamo acchariyo abbhuto dhammo saṃvijjati. 12.
an8.22:10.1: Sace kho panāhaṃ bhante Bhagavato paṭhamataraṃ kālaṃ kareyyaṃ, anacchariyaṃ kho pan' etaṃ, yaṃ maṃ Bhagavā evaṃ vyākareyya
an8.22:10.2: ‘natthi taṃ saṃyojanaṃ, yena saṃyojanena saṃyutto Uggo gahapati Hatthigāmako puna imaṃ lokaṃ āgaccheyyā' ti.
an8.22:10.3: Ayaṃ kho me bhante aṭṭhamo acchariyo abbhuto dhammo saṃvijjati.
an8.22:11.1: Ime kho bhante aṭṭha acchariyā abbhutā dhammā saṃvijjanti.
an8.22:11.3: katamehi pāhaṃ aṭṭhahi acchariyehi abbhutehi dhammehi samannāgato Bhagavatā vyākato ti. 13.
an8.22:12.1: Atha kho so bhikkhu Uggassa gahapatino Hatthigāmakassa nivesane piṇḍapātaṃ gahetvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi.
an8.22:12.2: Atha kho so bhikkhu pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
an8.22:12.3: Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu, yāvatako ahosi Uggena gahapatinā Hatthigāmakena saddhiṃ kathāsallāpo, taṃ sabbaṃ Bhagavato ārocesi. 14.
an8.22:13.2: yathā taṃ Uggo gahapati Hatthigāmako sammā vyākaramāno vyākareyya, imeh' eva kho bhikkhu aṭṭhahi acchariyehi abbhutehi dhammehi samannāgato Uggo gahapati Hatthigāmako mayā vyākato;
an8.22:13.3: imehi ca pana bhikkhu aṭṭhahi acchariyehi abbhutehi dhammehi samannāgataṃ Uggaṃ gahapatiṃ Hatthigāmakaṃ dhārethā
